statement: Linux Bluetooth-bus UHID is the recommended first realization because its HID parent can exercise hid-wiimote binding, native evdev, hidraw, LEDs, power and rumble; plain uinput can approximate gamepad input but cannot reproduce the HID parent, raw protocol or Wii driver sysfs on its own.

applicability.revision: Wii U Pro; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: Realization recommendation; BUS_BLUETOOTH metadata alone is not over-the-air discovery, pairing or reconnect.
